input.standard: ASTM E741 (tracer gas decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure the volume of air V_lab served by scrubber-1-v3 from V = Qe * tau, occupant CO2 as source, scrubber as pump.

steps.why: Rise: reduce effective flow to the speed floor so the lab CO2 climbs toward a higher equilibrium, hatch closed and held.
Decay: full speed (Qe about 1 m3/min), record the decay for about one time constant (tau about 30 min plus 3.33 min scrubber lag), hatch still closed.

monitoring.reason: Sole occupant of the lab, the volume whose CO2 is raised; hab-b (3 people) is followed through co2-2 and vitals abort also fires if one more person enters the lab.

abort.when: lab CO2 at or above 3000 ppm
the device refuses a step's command
FE-3 out of the 45-120 bpm band, monitoring lost, or one more person in the lab

expected.hypothesis: Lab is one well-mixed zone, hatch closed and held, steady source from one awake occupant (0.38 L/min = 0.00038 m3/min), Qe = 1 m3/min at full speed and about 0.3 m3/min at 30 percent (linear in speed).
expected.first_guess_V: 30 m3 (default, stated as a first guess only, range 10-200); tau_full = V/Qe about 30 min, plus 3.33 min lag; tau at 30 percent about 100 min.
expected.rise: From 1200 ppm, equilibrium at 30 percent about 1200+0.00038*(1/0.3-1)*1e6 = about 2100 ppm; in 25 min about +200 ppm rise (peak about 1400-1500 ppm). Stays under co2MaxPpm 2500; no abort expected.
expected.decay: Fit C(t)=C_eq+(C_0-C_eq)exp(-t/tau) toward equilibrium (about 1200 ppm at full speed), not toward zero; V_lab = Qe*tau, expected about 30 m3 (plausible 10-200).
expected.hypotheses_hold_if: Decay is single exponential, fit residuals within sensor noise, co2_habb stays flat and scrubber accepts both commands.
expected.hypotheses_fail_if: co2_habb moves with co2_lab (hatch exchange; station-topology gives 3 m3/min design flow with hatch closed, which would inflate apparent V), decay is bi-exponential or fitted V is far from Qe*tau consistency, the rise is too small to exceed noise (then repeat with longer rise), or occupancy changes.

hypotheses: Exchange through the closed hatch to hab-b is NOT measured and not assumed zero: station-topology states a 3 m3/min design flow with hatch closed; co2_habb is recorded to reveal it, and V may be overestimated if it is large.
Scrubber effective flow taken from the datasheet (1 m3/min at full, scaled linearly with speed) and its lag 3.33 min; not measured here.
Occupant CO2 rate held steady at the awake value 0.38 L/min (0.26-0.45); occupant activity and number unchanged during the test.
Lab air well mixed (single zone); sensor co2-1-v3 representative.
First guess of V (30 m3) is a default, only used to size the phase durations.
